lines.trans: Whatever all the others say, you can forget about that.
There is only one important rule here: listen to what I say.
Respect me, and then everything is fine.
In this shop I am the alpha wolf, so to speak.

words.gram: prep. + def. art., dat. sg. masc.

lines.trans: So, that is the stockroom, and this here is the cold room.
Okay, got it.
Open the door so that you understand how it works.
A box must always go between the door and the wall, otherwise pressure builds up.
Wait, where is the pizza? You have to wedge the box back in!
Whatever all the others say, you can forget about that.
There is only one important rule here: listen to what I say.
In this shop I am the alpha wolf, so to speak.
